text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the cafeteria at lunchtime…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see. So it's not just the products one uses that make a difference, but also the way in which one washes and dries their hair.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Exactly. How you dry it is especially important. That has an enormous effect on your styling options the next day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I knew I could count on you for advice. Thanks so much for letting me pick your brain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide is busily chatting away with Gold City, seemingly on the subject of hair care.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Hello.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's right. City here is a professional model. I thought I might ask her for some hair care tips.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Personally, I don't really think you need to worry about it so much.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Your hair is super beautiful. You have really nice natural waves, and―

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, trust me, you don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My hair's only the way it is because I'm constantly doing battle with it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If I neglect it for even one day, it ends up looking like a raging dragon.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …A raging dragon, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, how about this? Let me help find you a good stylist.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A lot of places specialize in hair care now, so there's bound to be a place that fits the bill for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You'll help me find a place? That would be wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay, so, this place is one hundred percent organic.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: They use really good treatment products. Plus, it's close, which is super convenient.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Yes, finding someplace close by would certainly be a bonus.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then there's this salon, which is really popular right now. Their slogan is, "A brand new you, starting with your scalp."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My! That's quite the lofty promise!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's supposed to be amazing. Scalp cleansing changes your hair at a fundamental level, they say!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Really, now? If you're saying it might actually tame these unruly curls of mine, that is surely something to consider!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh… Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It looks like they moved. Out west, to Kansai…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Kansai's probably a little far for you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, it could be worth it… If it's for a brand new me…
choice_data_list: You can't seriously be thinking about going to Kansai!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gah! I know, I know! I get it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But it's a brand new me we're talking about here! Don't you think that would be worth the trip?
choice_data_list: I think a place nearby would suffice.
Well, maybe we can just go next time we're in Kansai?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. I suppose, logically speaking, that is a reasonable assessment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-but… I finally found someplace that might help me, so try to understand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, there are other good salons with scalp care too, you know! Much closer than Kansai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Look. There's this one. And this one! These look like they'd do the trick.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City and I expend considerable effort trying to persuade Biwa Hayahide not to travel cross-country for scalp care.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah! I didn't even think of that! That's a great idea, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We can stop by next time we visit the Hanshin Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wow. You serious?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm serious! It's for a brand new me! Starting with my scalp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I can hardly wait. I'll beat everyone in the race, and then I'll beat this raging dragon on my head to boot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Biwa Hayahide gathers as much information as she can about the salon and Hanshin Racecourse, in preparation for the "big day."
